typical_topologies: The interface is a point-to-point or point-to-multipoint SerDes link organized

id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
fields.topology_type: Point-to-point (or point-to-multipoint) serial link between a Converter Device (M converters) and a Logic Device over L unidirectional differential lanes. ADC links run converter->logic; DAC links run logic->converter. A shared Device Clock and (Subclass 1) SYSREF provide common timing.

supported_topologies.name: Single-lane link
supported_topologies.description: L=1; one converter device to one logic device.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-lane link
supported_topologies.description: L=2/4/8 (up to 32); lanes aligned to a common multiframe via ILAS.

supported_topologies.name: Multiple converters to one logic device
supported_topologies.description: Several converter devices aligned (SYSREF) to one FPGA/ASIC.

supported_topologies.name: Multiple links per converter device
supported_topologies.description: One converter device hosting more than one link.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Holds the ADC/DAC; transmitter on an ADC link, receiver on a DAC link.
FPGA/ASIC; receiver on an ADC link, transmitter on a DAC link.
Provides the common Device Clock and (Subclass 1) SYSREF.
Unidirectional differential SerDes pair carrying the line-coded payload.

fields.interconnect_role: JESD204 is a converter-to-logic streaming transport: it serializes converter samples over L lanes with deterministic, repeatable latency (Subclass 1/2). It is not a packet-routing fabric; the data is ordered by lane/converter/sample position within the frame/multiframe.

ordering_guarantees.sample_order: Samples are delivered in frame/multiframe order, striped across L lanes, aligned at the multiframe boundary.
ordering_guarantees.deterministic_latency: Subclass 1/2 guarantee repeatable converter-to-logic latency via the SYSREF/SYNC~-aligned LMFC.
ordering_guarantees.lane_alignment: ILAS aligns all lanes to a common multiframe; /A//F/ maintain it (204B).

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: JESD204 is addressless streaming transport; there are no memory or peripheral address regions. Link parameters are configured via the vendor control bus (SPI) and the in-band ILAS link-config octets.

device_classification.converter_device: ADC/DAC device (TX for ADC, RX for DAC).
device_classification.logic_device: FPGA/ASIC (RX for ADC, TX for DAC).
